mappings.rationale: The concept of microglia activation assessed by Iba1 staining is a cellular biology measure that cannot be mapped to any variable in the CDC natality public-use file.
The concept of cell death assessed by cleaved caspase 3 (CC3) staining is a cellular biology measure that cannot be mapped to any variable in the CDC natality public-use file.
The concept of glutamatergic transmission assessed in the nucleus accumbens and amygdala is a neuroscience measure that cannot be mapped to any variable in the CDC natality public-use file.

The concept of hypoglossal motor nucleus assessed by electrophysiological recordings from brainstem slices is a neuroscience measure that cannot be mapped to any variable in the CDC natality public-use file.

source_summaries.cdc_natl15: The CDC natality public-use file contains variables related to demographic, socioeconomic, and health-related factors of births. It does not include biological or neurological measures such as microglia activation, cell death, glutamatergic transmission, or electrophysiological assessments of the hypoglossal motor nucleus.
